messages:
alex: Hey team — evaluating a short pilot with SpendSavvy (cost observability). They want to start a 6-month pilot with an SKUs-based bundle and an auto-renew clause. Can finance/procurement weigh in on red flags and negotiation levers?

mira: Thanks Alex. Can you paste the proposed price tiers and expected monthly ingest? We need to compare unit economics to a usage-based quote. :thinking_face:

alex: Sure — high level: 
```
Pilot: $8k/month (up to 50M tokens/day processed),
Overage: $0.000015/token,
Enterprise SKU (alerts+SAML+retention): $2k/mo add-on,
Auto-renew: yes, 12mo increments unless canceled 30 days before renewal
```
Estimated for our pilot: ~12M tokens/day avg -> ~3.6B tokens/month -> baseline fits under pilot cap most days but spikes matter.

kevin: Oof the auto-renew + 30d termination is thin. Two quick asks: can we switch pilot to month-to-month with committed discounts and request a hard max spend cap? Also want a sample billing export (CSV) — we need line-level meter mapping.

lina: Legal flag: avoid auto-renew and require at least 60 days notice. Also push for a price cap and an explicit data deletion clause at termination. Suggest this contract language to propose: 
```
No automatic renewal. Client may terminate with 60 days' written notice prior to the end of the Term. Vendor shall not increase per-unit prices during the Term. Upon termination, Vendor will securely delete Customer data within 30 days and provide written certification.
```

procurement-bot: FYI — standard SOW/PO process applies. For pilots >$5k/mo we need vendor questionnaire (security + SOC2) and a signed MSA. Initiate vendor onboarding ticket if proceeding. :white_check_mark:

sam: From eng side — integration looks light (API + webhooks) but retention add-on is necessary for our analytics. We also need to confirm whether KV cache or raw token data is exported (PII risk). Can we get a sandbox with sample billing?

mira: I'll ask sourcing to run a parallel cost quote from SpendSight and LedgerLens for comparison. If SpendSavvy won't drop auto-renew, we should try to convert the pilot to a capped proof-of-value with an explicit spend ceiling and rollback clause.

alex: Thanks — action items: 1) Mira to get 2 competitive quotes; 2) Kevin to request billing export & sample data; 3) Lina to propose redline for termination/data deletion; 4) Mira to open onboarding ticket if security questionnaire is OK. I'll hold off signing anything until we have the billing CSV and legal redline. :thumbsup:
